build_Sampler_class: build a python module that initializes a Sampler with epsilon-greedy, multinomial, or uniform sample policy
create_Sampler_sample: create a function that samples actions from a state distribution using epsilon-greedy or multinomial methods
test_Sampler_init: test the Sampler class initialization with custom sample_policy, greedy, epsilon, and sample_nodes arguments
review_Sampler_on_get_args: review the Sampler _on_get_args method that parses semicolon-separated sample_nodes into policy-action tuples
refactor_Sampler_sample: refactor the Sampler sample method to support uniform and original_distribution sampling policies
